verdict.rationale: No bulk or batch operation is documented. Bulk work is only implied: the SDK offers entity CRUD (the example shows a single create), you can connect your own scripts or agents to an app's sandbox, the CLI can run commands against any app on the account, and AI agents can update records. Global theme settings that update the whole app at once are a styling feature, not bulk data operations. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch API or UI action for many records at once, bulk operations via the CLI or MCP, and hands-on corroboration.
